name: Incident Response
tagline: Incident response console: a calm crisis screen with timeline, orange alert, sole ownership and status labels.
best: SRE/incident management, outage response, shift dashboard
signature: **Timeline:** each event 44px row, clock mono on left side.
**Orange warning:** accent only open event and action.
**Ownership:** one name, one role per line.
**Calm crisis:** 4 KPI limit, no charts.
must: The time, owner, and status are written on each event line.
Accent is open/critical only.
Up to 4 KPIs per screen.
essence: Incident Response maintains readability in a crisis: one timeline, one owner, one next step.
brief: Design incident response screen: dark background, timeline, orange only on open incident, 4 KPI limit, mono clock.

name: FinOps Cost
tagline: Cloud cost dashboard: green savings indicator, right-aligned amounts and budget threshold lines.
best: cloud cost management, budget panel, purchasing
signature: **Right-aligned amounts:** lowercase currency, tabular number.
**Green accent:** savings and confirmation; Red is my only love.
**Budget line:** dashed threshold line on the chart.
**Simple painting:** There is no zebra, there is a hairline.
must: Amounts are tabular and right-aligned; currency in each row.
The budget threshold is shown as a dashed line in the chart.
Accent only savings/confirmation.
essence: FinOps Cost ties each amount into a decision question: how much, which team, where relative to the budget.
brief: Design cloud cost dashboard: open floor, right-aligned tabular amounts, green accent on savings, dashed budget threshold.

name: Fleet Dispatch
tagline: Fleet dispatch screen: vehicle cards on the map, blue route accent and mono ETA columns.
feeling: lively but orderly, "each vehicle a line"
signature: **Map + list:** left map, right vehicle list 44px row.
**Blue route:** accent only active route and selected vehicle.
**ETA column:** mono, in minutes.
**Status banner:** 3px left margin with text label.
must: ETA and distance mono; unit is written.
Vehicle status with both color and label.
Opaque card for readable contrast on the map.
essence: Fleet Dispatch uses the map as a table, not decoration: each vehicle a row, each row an ETA.
brief: Design fleet dispatch screen: dark background, left map panel, right vehicle list, blue accent only active route, mono ETA.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 26ch; }
.pg-media { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 32px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 32px); }

name: Fraud Review
tagline: Risk review queue: a cautious review screen with purple alert, evidence panel and single decision button.
signature: **Evidence panel:** left signals, right trade summary.
**Purple accent:** review status; red only confirmed fraud.
**Decision button:** one primary, two secondary; The justification for the decision is mandatory.
**Risk score:** 0–100 mono, color scale 3 levels.
must: Risk score and justification are displayed together.
Decision buttons are reversible; The confirmation text is written clearly.
Accent solo review status.
mustNot: Automatic button that recommends decisions without evidence.
essence: Fraud Review does not speed up the decision; Organizes evidence. Each signal is a single line, each decision is a single justification.
brief: Design fraud review screen: dark background, left signal list, right transaction summary, purple accent review status, single decision button.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 26ch; }
.pg-card { border-top: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 44%, var(--line)); }

name: SLO Budget
tagline: Error budget dashboard: blue threshold line, remaining budget indicator, and mono error rate columns.
best: reliability dashboard, SLO/SLA tracking, platform team
signature: **Budget indicator:** single largest percentage + remaining minutes.
**Threshold line:** two references (target/limit) in the chart.
**Blue accent:** healthy; Amber is only subthreshold.
**Dense table:** 44px row per service.
must: The target and boundary are labeled on the same chart.
Error rate two decimal, mono.
Color thresholds are also written in text.
essence: SLO Budget reduces abstract reliability to a single number: the remaining error budget and the services that consume it.
brief: Design SLO board: dark background, single large budget percentage, threshold line chart, mono error rate chart.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 24ch; }
.pg-band b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 28px; }

name: Data Lineage
tagline: Data family tree display: node lines, pale cyan accent, and mono schema labels.
feeling: systematic, mapped, "where does the resource come from?"
best: data catalog, ETL tracking, schema documentation
signature: **Node language:** each table is a box, edges 1px, no arrowheads.
**Cyan accent:** selected path only.
**Mono identity:** table names are mono, typography is minimal.
**Schema label:** columns 11px mono, row 28px.
must: Table and column names are mono and readable (≥11px).
Accent is not used outside the selected path.
The source/target role is written on each node.
essence: Data Lineage reads the data flow like a map: boxes, lines and role labels; no ornaments.
brief: Design data family tree display: dark background, box nodes, cyan only on selected path, mono schema labels.

name: Access Audit
tagline: Access control: gray table, red lone violation, mono identity and immutability emphasis.
best: audit log, access review, proof of compliance
signature: **Fixed line:** 40px, mono id and timestamp.
**Red only violation:** accent decorative is not used.
**Immutability:** record number and source on each line.
**Gray scale:** interface neutral; Color carries information.
must: The timestamp is in ISO format and mono.
The rule ID is written on each violation line.
The table can be exported; column order is fixed.
mustNot: Hidden column (audit record cannot be decremented).
essence: Access Audit turns a table into evidence: each row by who, when, from what source, and by what rule.
brief: Design access control screen: neutral gray interface, 40px solid row, mono timestamp, red only in violation.

name: Release Train
tagline: Release calendar: weekly trend line, purple status tag and mono release numbers.
best: release planning, CI/CD dashboard, product calendar
signature: **Train line:** horizontal 2px line, stops 10px circle.
**Purple accent:** only next stop.
**Version label:** mono `v1.24.0`, right-aligned.
**Status banner:** color + text (scheduled/on air/undone).
must: Version number semver and mono.
The stops are chronological; Retrievals are marked.
Accent is just the next step.
essence: Release Train shows the release cadence on a line: each stop a release, each release a date.
brief: Design release calendar screen: dark background, horizontal train line, purple lonely next stop, mono semver labels.

name: Support Inbox
tagline: Support inbox: three columns, yellow priority, short reply templates and mono SLA counter.
best: support desk, ticket queue, live chat panel
signature: **Three columns:** tail 260px, conversation, context panel.
**Yellow-brown accent:** priority and selected row.
**Template chips:** single row, limit of 6 stencils.
**SLA counter:** mono, remaining time.
must: The wait time for each ticket line is mono.
Response templates maximum 6; single line.
The priority is both color and label.
essence: Support Inbox answers three questions on one screen: who's waiting, how long they've waited, what to answer.
brief: Design support inbox: three columns, yellow-brown accent priority, mono SLA counter, template chips.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 26ch; }
.pg-card { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,24,21,.06); }

name: Regulatory Report
tagline: Compliance report: official document layout with serif header, numbered section, gray table and single dark blue accent.
best: compliance/regulation report, annual notification, audit file
signature: **Numbered section:** 1 / 1.1 / 1.1.1 hierarchy.
**Serif body:** Lora 16px/1.7, size 68ch.
**Navy blue accent:** link and seal of approval only.
**Gray painting:** border striped, no zebra.
must: Chapter numbers and titles are consistent.
Unit and source footnote in each table.
Text does not exceed 68ch.
essence: Regulatory Report keeps a document on the screen like a document: numbered section, source footnote, metric serif.
brief: Design compliance report page: serif body, numbered sections, navy blue accent only on link, gray border striped table.
